Class BoardVisuals

java.lang.Object
com.tetris.ui.BoardVisuals
public class BoardVisuals extends Object
A container class holding references to the visual components of the board.

This class acts as a central registry for all the JavaFX Rectangle nodes currently active in the game scene. Instead of passing four separate lists/arrays between the initialization and refresh logic, this single object is passed.

Author:
Jacob Villegas

    • displayMatrix

      public javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle[][] displayMatrix
      The grid of rectangles representing the static background board.

    • brickRects

      public javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle[][] brickRects
      The grid of rectangles representing the currently falling active piece.

      Dimensions: [4][4] (Maximum size of a Tetris block rotation box).

      public javafx.scene.shape.Rectangle[][] ghostRects
